sources.title: Cosmos 3 - NVIDIA Documentation Hub
sources.snippet: Cosmos 3 # Cosmos 3 is a family of omnimodal world models for Physical AI. The models jointly process and generate language, images, video, audio, and action sequences using a unified Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Cosmos 3 supports Reasoner and Generator runtime surfaces for world understanding, world generation, and action modeling. For model code and examples, see the Cosmos GitHub ...
